---
title: "W1: Introduction"
---

## Objectives

This opening week introduces the basic concepts and practices of data science, with an emphasis on the data toolset. On completion, students will be able to:

- Explain the value and basic concepts of data science.
- Investigate a simple dataset using Python in RStudio.
- Present a replicable, reproducible analysis using Quarto.
- Write basic programs in Python
